thread:
Alex: Quick heads-up — noticed inconsistent behavior when cancelling mid-stream across SDKs (Node / Python / Go). Node leaves TCP open for ~30s, Py closes immediately, Go returns EOF quickly. Anyone else?
Maria: Yep, ran into this on the chat streaming test. Node ended up spamming backend with idle keepalive.
Todd: I think it's due to how we map AbortController -> transport: Node retries keepalive after abort, Python calls close().
Alex: repro steps: start streaming generation, then call abort on client after first chunk. Node logs show `stream: received cancel signal, ignoring` (weird)
Maria: paste of Node snippet: ```js
const ac = new AbortController();
fetch(url, { signal: ac.signal }).then(r => r.body.getReader())
ac.abort();
```
Rachel: Go uses `context.WithCancel()`; we cancel context and the server handler sees Done() and returns. No spin.
Todd: So behavior is transport + runtime specific (fetch vs requests vs net/http). Also HTTP/2 vs HTTP/1.1 differences matter (RST_STREAM vs closing connection).
Alex: Proposal: define a canonical abort contract for SDKs: "client abort should signal transport to close stream immediately and surface a CancelledError to caller; no silent retries".
Maria: Agreed. Also we should document server expectation: on RST_STREAM (http2) treat as client-cancel and stop work asap, emit metrics `requests.cancelled_by_client`.
Rachel: Can we add a small e2e harness that runs Node/Py/Go clients against a toy server to assert the server sees Done() within 500ms of client abort?
Todd: +1. I can sketch the harness (Go server, Node/Py clients) — will do a WIP branch.
Alex: Action items: 1) Devex doc PR describing canonical contract (owner: Alex) 2) e2e harness (owner: Todd) 3) SDKs add explicit mapping notes + examples (owners: language SDK leads).
Maria: Also add a short example for 'graceful drain' where caller sets a small timeout before abort to let server finish final token. e.g. `setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 200)` for last token flush.
Rachel: For retries: abort must cancel all in-flight retries. If retry policy kicks in after abort, that's a bug.
Alex: Can someone file an issue for Node SDK's keepalive behavior? Devex Bot: created issue #DFX-742 (soft-cancel-node-keepalive) and linked the thread. :thumbsup:
Devex Bot: Reminder — standup sync on Friday to confirm progress.
Maria: I'll open the doc PR later today. TL;DR: canonicalize abort semantics + test + examples.
Todd: I'll drop a branch link when ready.
Alex: Thanks all — this sync saved me a lot of back-and-forth. :rocket:
